model: RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn, 500 trees, random_state=42) on all 8 raw features
notes: Dropped 57 exact duplicate rows before a stratified 80/20 split (691 train / 173 test) to avoid leakage. Zeros in glucose/blood_pressure/skin_thickness/insulin/bmi were kept as-is as the forest handles them; no imputation.
